headline_hook: Jane Street Dumps Figma for Claude While Open Source Ships 25 Models in a Week
preview_topics: the 10x cost hack for multi-agent loops

pick_of_the_day.thesis: When a firm that optimizes every microsecond of its trading systems voluntarily replaces a visual tool with a text-based AI, it signals that the design→code boundary is collapsing — and the firms that recognize 'design' as a prompting skill will ship 10x faster than those still round-tripping through mockup tools.

model_literacy.relevance: Google's Gemma 4 QAT checkpoints are already running locally via Unsloth's GGUF conversions — QAT produces models that expect to be quantized, so they lose far less quality at 4-bit than post-training quantization. This is why the open-weight flood matters: QAT makes 12B models practical on laptops.
